key_insight: MedPAO-VL replaces one-shot radiology report generation with an explainable plan-act-observe agent that iteratively corrects itself to improve structure and factual alignment.
clinical_relevance: The approach aims to make chest X-ray report generation more trustworthy, protocol-compliant, and clinically usable by reducing hallucinations and improving report completeness.
method: Perceives chest X-rays with an explainable vision module that models diagnostic uncertainty
Uses a plan-act-observe loop to detect semantic discrepancies and refine the report iteratively
Targets structured, protocol-compliant radiology report generation rather than free-form text
evidence_signal: The abstract reports expert-rated performance of 3.5/5 for accuracy and 4.3/5 for structural quality.
watch_item: Promising results are from expert ratings in a specific chest X-ray setting, so broader validation and workflow testing are still needed before clinical deployment.
paper_title: MedPAO-VL: Interpretable and Protocol-Compliant Agent for Structured Radiology Report Generation
